name: tinker-bilibili-downloader
description: Bilibili Video Downloader Plugin for TINKER

tinker.name: Bilibili Downloader
tinker.description: Download Bilibili videos with quality selection

zh-CN.name: B站视频下载
zh-CN.description: 下载哔哩哔哩视频，支持画质选择

query.description: Parse a Bilibili video URL and return title, pages, and available quality options. Call this before download. Updates the plugin UI.

download.description: Download the video previously queried via the query tool. Optionally override quality and page selection. Waits until downloads finish and returns task results. Requires download path in plugin settings.

quality.description: Quality id from query.qualityOptions (e.g. 80 for 1080P). Defaults to the highest available from the last query.

pages.description: Page/episode numbers to download from query.pages. Defaults to all pages from the last query.

get_settings.description: Get current plugin settings: downloadPath and sessdata.

set_settings.description: Update plugin settings. Only provided fields are changed. Returns the settings after update.

sessdata.description: Bilibili SESSDATA cookie for higher quality / login-required videos
